main_text.head: Duæ: Nomen & Verbum.
DE NOMINE.
main_text.p: NOmen est vox numeri cum genere, casu & declinatione.

p.i: Comparatio, cujus gradus tres dicūtur, Positivus, Comparativus & Superlativus.

Si Positivo adjiciatur Adverbiū יותר jother, magis, fit Comparativus: sin מאד meod, valde, fit inde Superlativus, ut טוב tób, bonus, יותר טוב jother tób, magis bonus, id est, melior, מאד טוב meod tób, valde bonus, id est, optimus. Frequentius tamen Comparativus describitur per מן

page.notes: Hebrew words are printed inline with niqqud as shown. The "p 2" at the foot is a catchword-like signature mark, placed below the text; it is recorded as a foot note because it is a printed mark. Some Hebrew vowel points are small and may be imperfect. The Latin text "Coparatio", "Comparatiuus", "Superlatiuus" and similar forms show the printer's usual spelling. The bottom "p 2" may be a signature rather than a footnote; treated as a foot line here. The Hebrew "מן" at the end of the last line is printed as it appears, with the final word "per" before it.
